label: Seattle Police Department public data, as of 2026-11-24. 90-day snapshot 2026-08-27 to 2026-11-24. Not a real-time feed.
source: City of Seattle Open Data, SPD Crime Data: 2008-Present (dataset tazs-3rd5), Public Domain. Neighborhood boundaries are official SPD Micro-Community Policing Plan (MCPP) areas.
defaultWindowNote: Seattle’s default is this 90-day snapshot (2026-08-27 to 2026-11-24). Time presets are measured from the as-of date, 2026-11-24, not from today. The official Seattle dataset does not classify burglaries as residential or business; those incidents are shown if either burglary layer is on, and are labeled Burglary. The official offense dataset has no domestic-violence flag and no stalking records in this window.
locationPrecision: Official coordinates and block locations are already blurred to the 100-block. CrimeStat does not display or store street addresses. Map areas are official SPD MCPP neighborhoods. Incidents with no neighborhood and no usable 100-block point are counted but not placed on the map. This snapshot has no 911/CAD calls layer.
